items.title: Web Application Development
items.description: I design and build responsive, fast, and maintainable web applications from scratch — from the first line of code to deployment. Whether it's a marketing site, an internal tool, or a full product, I handle the entire stack myself.

items.title: Backend & API Development
items.description: I build reliable backend systems and APIs that your applications can depend on — clean architecture, proper error handling, and documentation that makes sense to the next developer who touches the code.

items.title: Automation & Integrations
items.description: From Telegram bots to workflow automation between your tools, I connect systems so your repetitive tasks disappear. If it can be scripted, it probably should be.

items.title: Technical Consulting & Code Review
items.description: Not sure if your current codebase is solid, or whether a new feature is worth building the way it's planned? I review, audit, and give you a straight, honest opinion — no upselling.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: We talk about what you actually need, not what sounds impressive. No obligation, no sales pitch.

steps.title: Scope & Estimate
steps.description: You get a clear scope, timeline, and price before any commitment — no surprises halfway through.

steps.title: Build in the Open
steps.description: Regular updates as I build. You see progress, not just a final reveal at the deadline.

steps.title: Delivery & Support
steps.description: You get working software, documentation, and a direct line to me if something needs fixing after launch.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Web applications, backends and APIs, and automation. I work best on small-to-medium projects with a clear goal — the kind where one careful developer is exactly the right team size.

items.q: How do pricing and timelines work?
items.a: Every project starts with a short discovery call. After that you receive a written scope, timeline and fixed price — before any work begins. The price doesn't move unless the scope does.
I do. There's no agency behind this site and nothing is handed off. The person who scopes your project is the person who builds it and stands behind it.

items.q: What happens after I get in touch?
items.a: We have a short call about what you need. If it's a fit, you get a written scope and price. Then I build — openly, with progress you can see — and deliver on the agreed date.
Small fixes on delivered work are part of it. Anything beyond that — new features, changes, ongoing maintenance — becomes a new, clearly scoped piece of work.
